title: Horus Telemetry Weekly Battery Voltage Trend
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=horus:telemetry battery_v=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(battery_v) as avg_duration, max(battery_v) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst battery voltage for Horus telemetry events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture battery_v on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average battery voltage with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts whether Horus telemetry tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
